description: This file defines the ShippingOption class, a Java model representing delivery options in the shipping module of the project. It includes properties like price, delivery dates, and identifiers, with methods to access and modify these properties.

classes.name: ShippingOption
classes.description: A Java class representing a shipping option, including price, delivery dates, and descriptive fields, implementing Serializable for object serialization.

methods.name: getOptionPrice
methods.description: Returns the shipping option price as BigDecimal. Parses optionPriceText if available, with error handling.

methods.name: setOptionPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the option price.

methods.name: getOptionPriceText
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the option price.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the shipping option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the shipping option.

methods.name: setEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Sets the estimated number of days for delivery.

methods.name: getEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the estimated number of days for delivery.
